profile.headline: Non terrae plus ultra
profile.summary:
Quirky, sometimes irreverent, but in a really good way, who likes to shake things up, make work more fun, and transform a plain-vanilla group into a team with flair and flavor. Not afraid to ignore his job description to get the job done but knows when to dial it back. Never afraid to publicly praise and speaks when others won't. 

Self-motivated by a wealth of curiosity, driven by something deeper and more personal than just the desire to do a good job. Rarely satisfied and constantly tinkering with something. Not willing to just follow processes but to actively find ways to make those processes even better, because it can't help it.

Decisive, results-oriented professional, recognized for excellence, creative problem solver that is able to adapt to rapidly changing environments and resolve mission-critical issues quickly and correctly. Constantly recognized by supervisors and managers for excellence in job performance. Fierce advocate for doing the right thing.

Experience with turning around service organizations and designing workflows/systems that address problems with holistic approaches at all levels.

A+ certified and a Microsoft Certified Professional with MCTS certification.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Fabric · Portainer · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
We own development and operation of automated performance experimentation, analysis, validation, monitoring, and alerting solutions based on methodologies and technologies developed by performance analysts in our sibling and partner teams. We closely collaborate with infrastructure owners on scenario execution and data collection, and work with data intelligence teams and component owners to drive performance improvements based on the signals produced by our analysis.

Our team works on both On-Prem and Cloud server performance scenarios.

On-Prem scenarios use sizable on-prem labs as well as elaborate test automation for setting up servers and clusters, conducting experiments and executing benchmarks, and collecting various performance measurements from both software and hardware for manual and automated analysis. You will be responsible for engaging with partner teams on test coverage and lab capacity planning; equipment procurement, deployment, and maintenance; test automation improvements and support; test content onboarding and support in collaboration with test content authors; test execution monitoring and troubleshooting.

Cloud scenarios leverage several internal and 3rd party services as well as our own common infrastructure deployed in Azure. You will be responsible for service compliance; access and subscriptions management; capacity and budget planning; resource utilization and downtime monitoring and troubleshooting; as well as 3rd party billing

positions.title: Senior Lead Consultant
positions.description:
Team lead supporting the Dev, PM, and QA organizations throughout WDG to ship their products with the needed engineering velocity. Provided customized, white glove, full service support to meet each organization’s individual needs, and the required resources while increasing the level of customer satisfaction.

-Provided project management services across internal customer teams on lab moves and consolidations, procurement, system bring ups, and other planned work outside of the day-to-day duties. Always delivered on time or early with rave reviews to the director level. Coordinated work across numerous teams on large scale projects.

-Supported day-to-day operation for all infrastructure and test clients with focus on servers for non-mission critical systems and applications working closely with Dev, QA, and PM to support all four tiers of applications.

-Demonstrated skill and passion for operational excellence. Ability to retain composure under stressful conditions and adapt on the fly to changing conditions as needed.

-Reduced procurement times with huge satisfactions in customer support surveys.

-Wrote PowerShell automation that reduced the amount of manual labor involved in patching systems eliminating unnecessary hours of work.

-Worked on sustainable system designs for workflow and team management that would scale, streamline, and improve quality of life for the team, and results delivered to customers.

-Oversaw the design and implementation of the Governance, Regulatory, and Compliance Protocol Interoperability mobile lab that traveled the country. This is a key and critical part of Microsoft’s obligations to partners in maintaining standards set forth by the Justice Department and the SEC.

positions.title: Senior Global Software Support Engineer
positions.description:
Acted as a Level 4 support member dealing with difficult subjects. Acted as the liaison between Customer Support and Software Development teams, working remotely with little direction yet remaining connected to the product and customer care teams. Also required to provide telephone and email support to Level 3 Customer Care personnel and Key Customer Accounts. Regularly triaged situations quickly, worked equally well with domestic/international support, software engineers, and external customers to bring about swift problem resolution.

-Self-starter and was able to work in unstructured environment. Outstanding troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with strong decision-making ability.

-Acted proactively with excellent follow-through, attention to details, communication, prioritization, and analytical skills. Strong understanding of support tickets, monitoring, and metrics. Consistently demonstrated skill and passion for operational excellence, and the ability to retain composure under stressful conditions.

-Experience handling International accounts with 25% International travel as well.

-Saw opportunities for improvement, took ownership and closely worked with development team to drive product improvement in a fast paced, ever changing environment.

-Linux, Android, Media/TV tuners and standards knowledge, (MPEG2, NTSC, PAL, SECAM, DVB-C/T/T2, etc.).

-Created business processes and workflows for reviewing the previous months work, identifying trends which drove the backlog and development roadmap. Using data from the newly created processes, we turned around and stabilized the product after a rough launch in under two years reducing the amount of support calls by 73%.

-Worked with the development team, and product managers to create features, write user stories, plan sprints, over see development of end user features based off customer feedback from the field, tools needed by support staff, test implemented stories, and oversee the roll out to end users.

positions.title: Operations Engineer
positions.description:
The Business Online Services Group which is under the Server and Tools organization at MS. The Communication Collaboration Service Team is responsible for Incident Management, Deployment and Capacity Expansion for Tier III BPOS Team.

Incident Management:
o	Trouble shoot server bugs, failed hardware, alerts from monitoring, document workflow processes.
o	Coordinated with large team across multiple shifts, time zone and departments of various specialties into one coordinated, cohesive response to incidents and issues.
o	Wrote an automation tool that reduced the time in diagnosing failed hardware leading to faster turnaround in tickets.

Change Management:
o	Supported deployments, deployed major bug fixes/releases, and enhance customer features/releases.
o	Worked with project management team as well as the Engineering teams to deliver software builds on time as requested by the customer.
o	Assisted in a record breaking service restore after a European data-center went offline due to a lightning strike that was high praised by the client.
o	Has never missed a day of work and has been the most consistent team member in the CM work space of his shift.
o	The only CM engineer to complete a patching cycle (automated Exchange cluster fail-overs and Active Directory server patching) in the North American data center on time with no misses.

positions.title: Server Ninja
positions.description: In charge of all LAMP stack servers that all client websites are hosted on and day to day operations of everything IT related.

positions.title: Technical Services Consultant
positions.description: Provide Tier 1 support for large companies and government organizations utilizing RAF's custom software and Tier 2 support to resellers who integrate RAF's commercial products. Determine and communicate workarounds/solutions when possible and communicate software problems to development for resolution. Act as a client advocate to ensure high customer satisfaction and maintain RAF's reputation in the industry.

positions.title: Refresh Technician
positions.description:
One month contractor for OS Technical to assist client (Union Bank) in transition period after purchasing Frontier Bank.

Project involved going into a bank after hours, removing old hardware, documenting all serial numbers, install new hardware, document serial numbers, run scripts and return old inventory.

positions.title: Website Administrator (Consultant)
positions.description: Website Administrator and Developer for Carlos Miller's website Photography Is Not A Crime. Everything from maintaining code, enhancements on the current system and developing new concepts and ideas for our new system falls under my purview.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Subcontractor for Burger King Corp, providing engineering support for Micros'​ MyInventory roll out for pilot restaurants.

• Wrote key documentation on business critical systems for our newly founded Chinese and Singapore IT branches. Systems were focused on data feeds of financial information from Burger King restaurants to our SAP system in our Corporate office.

• Developed a working proof-of-concept virtualization environment for our QA lab to reduce costs of software testing.

• Experimented with and developed procedures for supporting remote servers using out-of-band management (sometimes called lights-out management) that will reduce downtime, reduce the need for a dispatched technician and reduce our costs with supporting restaurants.

• Tested automated imaging software for all server restaurants that will allow any IT personnel to remotely re-image the server to an earlier backup reducing our technician dispatch and restaurant downtime to practically nothing for software related issues.

• Worked with vendors and priced out a VMWare system that would last five to ten years, virtualizing Burger King's point-of-sale showroom and QA lab while making a business case showing how this will reduce Burger King's ROI to almost instantly. Estimated savings is around $604,068.11 over the lifespan of the system.

• Recovered forgotten password of a laptop that had valuable data on it, negating the need of a specialist.

• Create an unattended and automated solution to fix a massive 700 restaurant software failure that McAfee caused reducing our downtime from a potential one to three months to just three days. Recognized for the creativity of my solution by the department manager, Senior VP & CIO of Burger King and published in magazines around Poland, UK, US and on technology publications online.

• Recovered a critical server that had been in limbo for over a year and contained an development SQL database used for reporting on restaurant systems.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Assisted current site administrator in Emotion Engine updates while fixing issue dealing with search in PHP. Also help out in the forums with moderation.

positions.title: Marketing Associate (Volunteer)
positions.description: Volunteer Marketing Associate in charge of writing all the copy on the website and other marketing materials.

positions.title: Network Administrator / Crestron Programmer
positions.description:
• Implemented a biometric time clock to improve internal payroll accuracy.
• Researched, configured and deployed an enterprise-level antivirus system that prevented lost man-hours. 
• Introduced new services and products to diversify with a new market and competitive advantage.
• Assisted in automating software deployment to workstations with Group Policy via Active Directory.
• Automated Tigerpaw CRM+ software that handled sales, order fulfillment, and project management.
• Designed and wrote marketing material for a public event at Calder Casino & Race Course.
• Optimized scheduling with one unified calendar and integrated Exchange for use of Outlook into the CRM. This gave employees who are unfamiliar with our CRM software the ability to schedule tasks.
• Improved accuracy of metrics in job costing, completion and project billing with the implementation of new policies and effective company training.
• Significantly improved inventory management system, resulting in more accurate counts and faster invoicing.

positions.title: Field Technician
positions.description:
• Lead call center and help desk technician for MetroPCS retail stores in North Florida and South Georgia.
• Assisted users in password resets, permission, email issues and other Active Directory/Exchange functions for several corporations both on-site and remotely using VNC, Terminal Server, LogMeIn and others remote applications.
• Installed and maintained Laserfiche, an OCR/paperless system for clients, reducing supply costs.
• Wrote technical documentation and end-user manuals for network assets and other hardware.
• Responsible for corporate networks and maintained uptime for user access on both LAN and remote VPN.
• Provided direct support, installation, training, and maintenance on telephones, domain controllers, file/email servers, routers, firewalls, and VPN to out of state locations.
• Specialized in deployment and support for desktops, laptops, and various mobile wireless devices including direct support for Linux, Mac, and Microsoft desktops and laptops.
• Provided direct support and documentation for an assortment of LAN/WAN and mobile environments.

positions.description: Third key holder and manager for GameStop.
